reason: The mapped fixtures are scheduled for 2026-10-20 through 2026-10-22. The schedule has date-only precision, so the collector correctly refuses to run before the latest fixture date plus 36 hours. No actual player/coach scores exist yet for these fixtures.

historical_limit: Historical weekly PDK/plusvalenza records are outcomes, not proof of the roster, prices, injuries, coach market, and lineup choices known before each tipoff. Do not retrofit those snapshots from post-game data; only rounds with authentic pre-match bundles can support a complete lineup backtest.
